name: tonari
title: tonari.no
shortDescription: Tonari creates portals that simulate in-person interactions across different locations, enhancing communication for teams, families, and educational settings. It uses high-fidelity video and low latency to create a seamless experience that feels like teleportation. For example, companies use Tonari to maintain daily face-to-face contact, boosting decision-making and team morale.
pros: Sub-100ms latency for natural, real-time interaction
Seamless integration with existing video conferencing tools
cons: High initial purchase cost starting at $24,999
